briefing_cards.headline: Hindustan Copper OFS opens for retail investors today. Should you apply in the metals major's offer?
briefing_cards.summary: The OFS opened for non-retail investors on August 4, and saw strong participation. It now opens for retail investors today. Investors can participate between 9.15 am and 3.30 pm using the separate OFS window on NSE and BSE. A minimum of 10% of the offer size has been reserved for retail investors.
briefing_cards.pl_impact: Opportunities to optimize CAC payback and expand high-yield cross-sell corridors (PMS, structured notes) across the active digital client base.
